description: Header file defining the 'Process' class and nested 'Options' class for process management, including launching, killing, and I/O handling, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Encapsulates process creation, management, and I/O operations with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Handles command-line options and argument construction for process execution.

methods.name: Process::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is still active.

methods.name: Process::HasConnector
methods.description: Indicates if the process has an I/O connector.

methods.name: Process::IsKilled
methods.description: Checks if the process was killed.

methods.name: Process::IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the process has terminated.

methods.name: Process::Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Process::Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, hard or soft kill.

methods.name: Process::WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for process completion within a timeout.
